title: Moss and the Gravel Path
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations u as yoo, c as s, g as j.

pages.brief: Moss the hedgehog watching an older hedgehog raking small stones into neat lines on a gravel path.
A close-up of neat, even lines raked into the grey gravel.
Moss the hedgehog reaching for a small rake leaning against the fence.
Moss the hedgehog raking with wobbly, crooked lines appearing in the gravel.
Moss the hedgehog looking down at his uneven lines with a small frown.
The older hedgehog guiding Moss’s paws, helping him hold the rake flat and steady.
Moss the hedgehog raking slowly and carefully, a new neat line forming.
A tidy row of straight lines now visible in the gravel where Moss has raked.
Moss the hedgehog smiling at the neat gravel path he has just finished.
Moss the hedgehog and the older hedgehog standing together, looking at the tidy gravel path.
